newsitem.title: UK: Edwards trims Man U stake to under 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Edwards trims Man U stake to under 15 pct.

text.p: Manchester United Plc chief executive Martin Edwards has trimmed his holding in the club to just under 15 percent, United said in a statement on Monday.

The Edwards family raised more than 5.9 million stg from the sale of almost 1.4 percent of the English soccer champions to an unnamed institutional investor. A company spokesman said the funds raised were for personal use.
Edwards sold 405,000 shares for 650p on July 11. His wife sold 5,000 shares and a trust holding shares for Edwards' children sold 500,000 shares at the 650p price.
Edwards now has 14.97 percent of the company's issued capital, around a quarter of which is held in the trust for his children.
He has gradually whittled his stake down from around 25 percent at the time of the club's flotation in 1991. United shares were unchanged at 650p on Monday.
